stories.notes: Text is the 1697 original in 17th-century spelling (estoit, luy, sçû, '&', 'Ie', 'Iusque'), exactly as on the validated Wikisource transcription, including its two original paragraphs and the 'MORALITÉ.' heading (kept as its own paragraph because it belongs to the 1697 text). No 19th-century modern-spelling edition on the allowed sites reproduces the 1697 wording faithfully: the 1826 (Collin de Plancy) and 1902 (Féron, Casterman) Wikisource editions change 'la plus jolie' to 'la plus éveillée' and other details, and the 1902 one drops the Moralité; the 1886 Montréal edition also alters the ending ('C’est pour mieux te manger'). If a modern-spelling version is needed it would have to be a modernisation of this text, which is an editorial step outside this research.
